recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD45 對側向散射（SS）圖：主要族群落在 CD45 弱至中度表現、低 SS 的「芽細胞閘」內（標為 A），另有一群 CD45 強陽性、低 SS 的成熟淋巴球；這種 CD45 dim 芽細胞群是急性白血病（此處為 T-ALL）的線索。
features: Flow cytometry density plot of CD45 PE-Cy5 (x-axis, log) versus side scatter (y-axis, linear)
Dominant population with dim to intermediate CD45 and low side scatter, enclosed in gate A (blast region)
Smaller separate population with bright CD45 and low side scatter (mature lymphocytes)
Only sparse events in the high side-scatter granulocyte region, indicating reduced maturing myeloid cells
Low-CD45 debris/erythroid events at the left of the plot
describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot shows a dominant population with dim to intermediate CD45 expression and low side scatter, gated as A in the blast region, separate from a smaller population of CD45-bright, low side scatter mature lymphocytes. Maturing granulocytes in the high side scatter region are sparse. This pattern indicates a predominance of blasts; lineage assignment requires additional markers, and in the context of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma the gated blasts would be expected to express cytoplasmic CD3, CD7 and TdT.
